body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#780, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. 

## Problem
Follow-up to #669, #685 and #705 (router constant resolution).
After router-resolution fixes, adopters cannot tell whether a map is now good enough to replace a hand-built map without reading the full map. Build exits 0 even when most screens are UNKNOWN.

## Proposal
`flows appmap stats --map FILE` (capped): screens resolved/total per app, unknowns by reason with top-5 example anchors, test-join state (resolved/UNKNOWN files, unbound page objects), edges by basis, selector strength histogram. Optional `--min-resolved PCT` exit-code gate.

## Acceptance criteria
- Deterministic, budget-capped; every count reconciles with the map.
- `--min-resolved` exits 1 below threshold with the dominant unknown reasons.
